name: Cactus Lantern Desert
description: A twilight desert where cacti bloom into glowing lantern flowers as travelers rest beside a campfire.
prompt: A single serene twilight desert scene where tall saguaro cacti bloom with glowing paper-lantern flowers in warm gold and rose. A small caravan of robed travelers rests beside a campfire, camels silhouetted, dunes rolling toward distant mountains. Deep violet sky with early stars, soft magical light, culture-inspired fantasy, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: The desert doesn't need streetlights—it grows them. Would you camp beneath the cactus lanterns?
